# gsc-mcp Architecture Quick Reference for AI Assistants
# Source: 16 ADRs + code archaeology (2026-10-05, Bing provider release)
# Load in CLAUDE.md: @docs/machine-readable/llms.txt

## What This Project Is

Python MCP server exposing 96 source Google Search Console / Bing Webmaster / GA4 / CrUX / IndexNow / drift-monitoring / content-audit / internal-linking / AI-visibility tools to AI agents.
Package: gsc-mcp-tools on PyPI. Entrypoints: gsc-mcp and gsc-mcp-tools (both → gsc_mcp.server:main).
Framework: FastMCP. Python 3.11+. MIT license.
Release 1.4.0 contains 89 tools, adding seo_change_impact, rewrite_fidelity_check, search_weekday_reference and crawl_import_preview to the 85-tool registry of 1.3.1. Draft inputs extend editorial_audit.
Setup guides: docs/installation.md, docs/google-setup.md, docs/bing-setup.md.
Prompt library: docs/starter-prompt.md and examples/.

## Module Map

ENTRY POINT: src/gsc_mcp/server.py : FastMCP("gsc-mcp") + registers registry.TOOLS (96 source tools by default), subject to startup family selection since 1.3.1.
REGISTRY: src/gsc_mcp/registry.py : Single source of truth. Dict[str, Callable] keyed by function name.
  assert set(TOOLS) == set(_ALL_TOOLS) at import time; any mismatch fails loudly.
  CLI (gsc-cli) reads the full TOOLS catalogue; the MCP server applies startup family selection since 1.3.1 through tool_selection.py and GSC_MCP_TOOL_FAMILIES, with all tools by default and core always exposed. Unknown or empty selections fail startup. Restart after changes; selection does not grant provider access. Both frontends read TOOLS. Adding a tool = update registry.py + properties._ALL_TOOLS; declare new module families in tool_selection.py.

CLI string lists: repeat flags or pass JSON arrays of strings; commas stay literal.
  Invalid arrays fail before provider access. JSON string-list form is available since 1.3.1.
Bing query stats (since 1.3.1): aggregate before limit by default; daily=True opts in.
  CTR uses summed counts, positions use corresponding available weights; invalid
  source CTR is null with preserved diagnostics, not clipped or hidden by aggregation.

AUTH: src/gsc_mcp/auth.py : Google service helpers plus a Bing env-key reader:
  get_searchconsole_service() → GSC Search Console API
  get_indexing_service()      → Google Indexing API
  get_ga4_service()           → GA4 Data API v1 (gRPC)
  get_alpha_ga4_service()     → GA4 Data API v1alpha (for ga4_funnel only)
  Resolution order: GSC_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_PATH env → OAuth JSON token at platformdirs user_data_dir.
  Token: JSON (NOT pickle), chmod 0o600, written atomically via tempfile + os.replace() (TOCTOU fix).
  Directory: chmod 0o700.
  Refresh: RefreshError on an expired token's refresh() call deletes the stale cached token and falls
  through to a normal re-auth instead of failing the same way on every subsequent call (v1.0.1).
  get_bing_api_key() reads BING_WEBMASTER_API_KEY. It never accepts a key from a tool argument.

OUTPUT CONTRACT: src/gsc_mcp/meta.py : with_meta(data, tool, params). Every tool returns:
  json.dumps(with_meta(data, tool="tool_name", params={...}))
  Data keys spread at top level. _meta block appended with tool name and call params.

RETRY: src/gsc_mcp/retry.py : @with_retry(max_retries=3, base_delay=1.0). Apply to any direct Google API call.
  Retries on: HttpError [429, 500, 502, 503, 504], ServiceUnavailable, ResourceExhausted, InternalServerError, BadGateway, RetryError.
  Does NOT retry other 4xx.

QUOTA: src/gsc_mcp/quota.py : QuotaTracker singleton. Indexing API limit: 200 req/day, warn at 180.
  In-memory only (resets on restart).

WRITE-TOOL PROTOCOL: submit_url, submit_batch, sitemaps_delete, indexnow_submit,
  submit_sitemap, bing_url_submit, bing_urls_submit_batch, bing_feed_submit and
  bing_feed_remove mutate external state. Read current state first, name the exact target and
  volume, get explicit confirmation, call once, then report only the returned status. Bing writes
  also enforce same-origin targets; bing_feed_remove requires confirm=true.

TOOLS:

  analytics.py (10 tools):
    get_search_analytics, get_advanced_search_analytics, get_performance_overview,
    get_search_by_page_query, compare_search_periods, analytics_anomalies,
    discover_performance, news_performance, search_type_breakdown, ai_overviews_impact
    Core: _fetch_rows() wrapped with @with_retry : shared by all analytics + SEO tools.

  seo.py (8 tools):
    quick_wins, traffic_drops, seo_striking_distance, seo_cannibalization,
    seo_lost_queries, check_alerts, parasite_risk, prune_candidates
    Built on _fetch_rows from analytics.py.
    parasite_risk: pure URL-path analysis (no HTTP fetch). Regex patterns for
      Google 2024-11-19 parasite SEO policy: sponsored/affiliate/partner paths (high),
      /advisor/ /underscored/ /select/ /commerce/ (medium), affiliate query params (low).
      site_risk = max risk across URLs. Verdicts: clean | at_risk | high_risk.
    prune_candidates: classifies pages into has_traffic, impressions_no_clicks,
      low_impressions, zero_impressions from 180 days of GSC data. Returns no
      "delete these" list by design; a page with clicks can never appear as a
      candidate. Non-regression case: 300 indexed local pages with traffic must
      never be recommended for deletion (tests/test_seo.py::test_prune_solar_panel_local_pages_are_protected).
    Since 1.3.1: traffic_drops current window ends today-3; lost queries retain today.
      Candidate diagnoses are metric rules, not causes. Missing current rows have
      metrics_current=null in unavailable_queries. Zero-impression CTR/position are null.
    Since 1.3.1: seo_cannibalization excludes site:/intitle:/inurl:/filetype: operators;
      excluded_search_operator_queries counts distinct strings; include_search_operators=True opts in.
    Bing support: quick_wins, seo_striking_distance and prune_candidates accept engine="bing".
      traffic_drops and seo_lost_queries return bing_exact_period_comparison_unavailable.
      check_alerts and seo_cannibalization return bing_bulk_page_query_dimension_unavailable.
      These refusals make no provider call and do not synthesize N+1 page-query data.

  inspection.py (3 tools): inspect_url, batch_url_inspection, check_indexing_issues

  indexing.py (3 tools): submit_url, submit_batch, indexnow_submit
    submit_batch: true multipart HTTP batch via svc.new_batch_http_request(), 100 URLs/request.
    indexnow_submit: POST to https://api.indexnow.org/indexnow (not Google, targets Bing/Yandex/Seznam/Naver).
      validate_url_strict per URL (SSRF-safe). No @with_retry (not a Google API).
      Verdicts: ok (200/202, 0 skipped) | partial (200/202, some skipped) | error.

  sitemaps.py (4 + 1 special):
    list_sitemaps, sitemaps_get, sitemaps_delete, submit_sitemap
    sitemap_audit: defusedxml + SSRF origin check + follow_redirects=False + 90 days GSC cross-ref.
    Verdicts: empty | fetch_error | partial (>20% URLs absent) | healthy.

  properties.py (3 tools): list_properties, get_site_details, get_capabilities
    _ALL_TOOLS list lives here. Update it when adding tools.
    get_capabilities returns the derived total plus declared Google/Bing credential env state.
    credential_env_declared is configuration presence, not an authentication check.

  bing_analytics.py (6 read tools):
    bing_query_stats, bing_page_stats, bing_page_query_stats, bing_rank_traffic_stats,
    bing_link_counts, bing_url_links.
    Search performance filters Bing rows to a requested local window but reports the observed
    window separately. CTR is derived from clicks/impressions. Bing position fields retain their
    own semantics. Backlink nested item schemas remain UNVERIFIED_RUNTIME.

  bing_webmaster.py (9 read + 4 write tools):
    Reads: bing_sites_list, bing_crawl_stats, bing_crawl_issues, bing_crawl_settings_get,
    bing_url_info, bing_url_traffic, bing_feeds_list, bing_feed_details,
    bing_url_submission_quota.
    Writes: bing_url_submit, bing_urls_submit_batch, bing_feed_submit, bing_feed_remove.
    All targets are strict public URLs on the same origin as site. Accepted writes return
    indexed=false and indexed_semantics=not_verified. Batch submission refuses before mutation
    while DailyQuota/MonthlyQuota total-versus-remaining semantics stay UNKNOWN. RemoveFeed,
    non-empty crawl issue rows and nested backlink rows remain UNVERIFIED_RUNTIME. No Bing write
    was executed against a production site during the validation recorded for this branch.

  search_compare.py (1 tool): compare_search_engines
    Compares query or page rows. Click/impression deltas require equal exact observed windows and
    a dimension present in both providers. CTR is derived after aggregation. Positions remain
    side by side because Google and Bing semantics differ. Recommendations default to an empty list.

  providers/ (modules, no tools):
    base.py defines SearchMetricRow/Batch, the minimal common metrics and provider_metrics.
    google.py supports query/page/date/country/device dimensions with window_exact=true.
    bing.py supports one of query/page/date, always reports window_exact=false and contains the
    redacted JSON/HTTP transport. GetKeywordStats and GetRelatedKeywords returned HTTP 400 in the
    live canary, remain UNKNOWN and are not registered as tools.

  ga4.py (8 tools):
    ga4_ai_referrals, ga4_traffic_sources, ga4_organic_landing_pages, ga4_page_performance,
    ga4_user_behavior, ga4_realtime, ga4_conversion_funnel, ga4_funnel
    ga4_funnel uses get_alpha_ga4_service() (v1alpha). All accept hostname + country filters.
    Filter helper: _build_dimension_filter(hostname, country, base_filter).
    env: GA4_PROPERTY_ID (validated lazily, per-call override supported).

  cross.py (4 tools):
    traffic_health_check, page_analysis, content_brief, page_health_score
    Compose analytics.py + ga4.py. Join via _normalize_url() (strips scheme/host/query/trailing-slash).
    engagement_rate = engaged_sessions / sessions.

  crux.py (3 tools): crux_page_vitals, crux_history, crux_lcp_subparts
    HTTP client: httpx (POST to Chrome UX Report API). Auth: CRUX_API_KEY (plain Google API key).
    HTTP 404 = verdict "not_enough_data" (not an error condition).
    crux_lcp_subparts: requests 5 metrics (lcp + 4 subparts). Missing CRUX_API_KEY = verdict "missing_key".
      Subparts: ttfb_ms, resource_load_delay_ms, resource_load_duration_ms, render_delay_ms.
      dominant_phase = short key name of subpart with highest p75 value.
      Verdicts: good | needs_improvement | poor | not_enough_data | missing_key | fetch_error.

  technical.py (5 tools): schema_validate, schema_generate, ai_visibility_audit, gbp_deprecation_lint, pagespeed_audit
    schema_validate: httpx fetch + html.parser (stdlib) extraction of <script type="application/ld+json">.
    No auth needed. Validates: Article, LocalBusiness, FAQPage, Product, WebSite, BreadcrumbList,
    SoftwareApplication, BlogPosting. SSRF-checked via url_safety.validate_url_strict.
    _DEPRECATED_RICH_RESULTS: FAQPage (May 2026), HowTo (Sep 2023), ClaimReview/EstimatedSalary/
      VehicleListing/SpecialAnnouncement (June 2025). Each schema dict includes deprecated_rich_result field.
    schema_generate: builds JSON-LD blocks for Reservation, OrderAction, DiscussionForumPosting, ProfilePage.
    No network calls. No auth needed.
    ai_visibility_audit: fetches {origin}/robots.txt via safe_fetch_html, parses with urllib.robotparser.
      Checks 10 AI crawlers: GPTBot, ClaudeBot, Claude-User, Claude-SearchBot, PerplexityBot, CCBot, Google-Extended,
      cohere-ai, Bytespider, OAI-SearchBot. Also checks {origin}/llms.txt for MCP discoverability.
      Verdicts: open | partial | closed | fetch_error.
      Mock targets: gsc_mcp.tools.technical.safe_fetch_html, gsc_mcp.tools.technical.validate_url_strict.
    gbp_deprecation_lint: safe_fetch_html + 5 regex patterns for deprecated GBP features.
      Patterns: .business.site links (sunset Mar 2024), Reserve with Google (deprecated Jun 2025),
      appointments widget, Maps Reserve flow, GBP chat widget.
      Verdicts: clean | deprecated_found | fetch_error. No auth needed.
    pagespeed_audit(url, strategy="mobile"): calls PSI API v5 via httpx.
      Returns Lighthouse performance score (0-100), 6 CWV metrics (fcp/lcp/tbt/cls/speed_index/tti),
      top 3 opportunities sorted by score ascending.
      Requires GOOGLE_API_KEY env var. Missing key = verdict "missing_key".
      Verdicts: good (>=90) | needs_improvement (50-89) | poor (<50) | missing_key | fetch_error.
      Mock target: gsc_mcp.tools.technical.httpx.Client (context manager pattern).

  url_safety.py (module, no tool): SSRF/DNS-rebinding protection.
    Public API: validate_url(), validate_url_strict(), safe_httpx_get(), safe_fetch_html().
    Blocks: private/loopback/reserved IPs, obfuscated IPv4 (decimal/hex/octal), link-local (169.254.x.x),
    multi-cloud metadata endpoints (AWS IMDS, Azure, GCP, Oracle, Alibaba).
    DNS pinning via _pin_dns() context manager (socket.getaddrinfo patch under lock).
    Use safe_fetch_html() for any tool that fetches an arbitrary user-supplied URL.
    Adapted from claude-seo (agricidaniel, MIT).

  drift.py (3 tools): drift_baseline, drift_compare, drift_history
    drift_baseline: fetch page via safe_fetch_html + store SEO snapshot in SQLite.
    drift_compare: fetch live + apply 17 rules (8 CRITICAL, 6 WARNING, 3 INFO). Dan Colta methodology.
    drift_history: read stored comparisons for a URL.
    Storage: sqlite3 in platformdirs.user_data_dir("gsc-mcp")/drift/baselines.db (WAL mode).
    CWV comparison optional, requires CRUX_API_KEY. No Google API calls otherwise.
    Adapted from claude-seo (Dan Colta, MIT).

  editorial.py (1 tool): editorial_audit(url=None, language="auto", genre="general", *, text=None, format="plain")
    Versioned FR/EN house-style warnings, eligible parsed text locations and faithful rewrite guidance.
    No authorship probability, ranking score, classifier call or content mutation. Unknown language/challenge/fetch failures remain unassessed.

  content.py (5 tools): content_quality, hreflang_audit, page_technical_audit, preload_audit, heading_audit
    content_quality: safe_fetch_html + stdlib TextExtractor (strips script/style/nav/footer). Scores:
      filler_score (hits per 1000 tokens * 25), information_density (entities+numbers/100 tokens / 10),
      repetition_score (bigram repetition * 100), overall_quality (weighted). Flags: filler, low-density,
      repetitive, thin-content. Verdicts: good | needs_work | thin_content | fetch_error.
      Filler phrase list adapted from claude-seo (agricidaniel, MIT). _AI_PATTERNS excluded (CC BY-SA 4.0).
    hreflang_audit: safe_fetch_html + MetaParser. Checks: self-ref, x-default, ISO 639-1 lang codes,
      ISO 3166-1 Alpha-2 region codes (jp→ja, UK→GB), mixed HTTP/HTTPS protocols.
      Verdicts: valid | issues_found | no_hreflang | fetch_error.
      Rules adapted from claude-seo skills/seo-hreflang/SKILL.md (agricidaniel, MIT).
    page_technical_audit: validate_url_strict + httpx.Client(follow_redirects=False). Checks:
      title length (30-60), meta description length (50-160), meta robots (noindex=critical), canonical
      presence + match, viewport, HTML lang, security headers (x-frame-options, x-content-type-options,
      referrer-policy), redirect detection (3xx), robots.txt Googlebot access via safe_fetch_html +
      urllib.robotparser.parse(). Verdicts: healthy | issues_found | fetch_error. No auth needed.
    preload_audit: safe_httpx_get (returns full httpx.Response including headers, SSRF-safe).
      Checks: <script type="speculationrules"> blocks + body JSON parsed for prefetch/prerender actions,
      Speculation-Rules HTTP response header, <link rel="preload"> with as/href/fetchpriority attrs,
      deprecated <link rel="prerender">, cache-control: no-store bfcache blocker.
      Verdicts: optimised | improvements_available | not_implemented | fetch_error.
      Mock target: gsc_mcp.tools.content.safe_httpx_get. Adapted from claude-seo (agricidaniel, MIT).
    heading_audit: safe_fetch_html + a dedicated _HeadingParser (drift.py's parser only
      covers h1-h3 and discards document order, both needed here; its output shape is
      persisted in drift baselines so it is deliberately left alone). Checks: H1 count
      (0 or 2+ = high severity), heading level jumps (H2 straight to H4), title vs H1
      word-for-word duplication (wastes a second angle on the keyword), headings carrying
      no information (FR+EN blocklist: "Introduction", "Conclusion", ...), words per H2.
      Verdicts: healthy | issues_found | fetch_error.

  links.py (2 tools): internal_links_audit, link_equity_map
    No auth needed, no quota consumed. Rules encoded from a working SEO consultant call
    (2026-08-06): a link only in the footer or nav carries far less weight than the same
    link in the body, and internal linking is worth as much as off-site link building.
    internal_links_audit(url): _LinkParser (stack-based, handles nested containers e.g.
      <nav> inside <header>) tags every <a href> with its zone (body, nav, footer, header,
      aside; role="navigation"/"contentinfo"/"banner"/"complementary" treated like their
      semantic tags). Headline output: footer_only_targets, internal targets linked from
      nav/footer/aside but from no page body. Also reports generic/empty anchors (FR+EN),
      internal rel=nofollow, self-links. Paths compared with trailing slash stripped.
      Verdicts: healthy | issues_found | fetch_error.
    link_equity_map(site, days=90, max_pages=25, delay_seconds=0.2): takes the top
      max_pages pages by impressions from get_search_analytics, crawls each with the same
      zone-aware parser, builds a directed internal-link graph, joins it to the GSC numbers.
      Outputs: underlinked_striking_distance (position 11-20 with no body inbound link,
      the cheapest ranking move), orphan_candidates (impressions but no body inbound link),
      footer_only_targets (site-wide), hub_pages (top body-link distributors). max_pages
      capped at 100. pages_crawled/pages_failed/coverage_note always returned; only crawled
      pages act as link sources, so "orphan" is scoped to that set, never a site-wide fact.
      Verdicts: healthy | issues_found | no_data.

## Security Rules (always apply)

1. XML PARSING: Use defusedxml.ElementTree, NEVER stdlib xml.etree.ElementTree, for external XML.
   Reason: XXE + billion-laughs vulnerability on untrusted XML.

2. TOKEN STORAGE: Write tokens as JSON (not pickle). Atomic write (tempfile + os.replace()).
   chmod 0o600 on file, 0o700 on directory.

3. BING SECRET: Read BING_WEBMASTER_API_KEY only from the environment. Never add it to tool
   signatures, _meta params, errors or logs. BingApiError contains only sanitized fields.

4. BING WRITES: Run validate_url_strict then validate_same_origin before any Bing mutation.
   Validate an entire batch before reading quota or writing. Never turn acceptance into an
   indexation claim.

5. CROSS-ENGINE COMPARISON: Emit click/impression deltas only for equal exact observed windows.
   Keep positions side by side and retain provider-specific metrics in provider_metrics.

6. SSRF (sitemap_audit + schema_validate + drift tools): All arbitrary URL fetches go through
   url_safety.validate_url_strict() or safe_fetch_html() from src/gsc_mcp/url_safety.py.
   Blocks private IPs, cloud metadata endpoints, obfuscated IPv4, localhost, link-local addresses.
   sitemap_audit additionally enforces origin match on child URLs + follow_redirects=False.

7. REAL PROPERTY IDs: Never hardcode real Google or Bing property IDs or domains in tests or docs.
   Use sc-domain:example.com or https://example.com/ as fixtures.

8. RETRY COVERAGE: All direct Google API calls (execute(), runReport(), etc.) need @with_retry().
   Missing decorator = unhandled transient failures.

9. OUTPUT CONTRACT: All tools must return json.dumps(with_meta(...)).
   No bare json.dumps(data).

10. CI SECRETS: PYPI_API_TOKEN lives in GitHub Actions secrets, never in pyproject.toml or code.

## Adding a New Tool (checklist)

1. Implement in tools/<module>.py : @with_retry() if Google API call; no decorator for non-API tools.
2. Return json.dumps(with_meta(data, tool="name", params={...})).
3. If the tool fetches an arbitrary user-supplied URL, use safe_fetch_html() from url_safety.py.
4. Import + add to TOOLS tuple in registry.py (server.py and gsc-cli pick it up automatically).
5. Add name to _ALL_TOOLS in properties.py. Counts derive from registry.TOOLS or _ALL_TOOLS.
6. Write tests in tests/test_<module>.py : mock every external API call.

## Test Patterns

SETUP: pytest tests/ : 1782 tests on the combined source checkout; provider calls are mocked, not live validation.
  pytest tests/test_analytics.py -v
  pytest tests/ -k "test_submit_batch" -v

FIXTURE CHEAT SHEET:
  mock_gsc_service     → MagicMock wired: .sites().list, .searchanalytics().query, .sitemaps(), .urlInspection()
  mock_indexing_service → MagicMock with working new_batch_http_request() (fires callbacks synchronously)
  GA4_PROPERTY_ID      → autouse fixture sets env var to "12345678"

PATCH AT CALL SITE (not in module declaration):
  gsc_mcp.tools.analytics.get_searchconsole_service
  gsc_mcp.tools.ga4.get_ga4_service
  gsc_mcp.tools.crux.httpx.Client              ← context manager pattern
  gsc_mcp.tools.sitemaps.httpx.Client          ← context manager pattern
  gsc_mcp.tools.sitemaps.get_search_analytics  ← module-level import, patch here
  gsc_mcp.url_safety.socket.getaddrinfo        ← DNS mock for schema_validate + drift tools
  gsc_mcp.tools.drift.safe_fetch_html          ← patch directly for drift tests
  gsc_mcp.tools.drift._fetch_cwv               ← patch to return None or a CWV dict
  gsc_mcp.tools.content.safe_fetch_html        ← patch for content_quality, hreflang_audit, page_technical_audit robots.txt
  gsc_mcp.tools.content.validate_url_strict    ← patch for page_technical_audit SSRF test
  gsc_mcp.tools.content.httpx.Client          ← context manager pattern for page_technical_audit main fetch
  gsc_mcp.tools.content.safe_httpx_get        ← patch for preload_audit (returns MagicMock with .text, .status_code, .headers)
  gsc_mcp.tools.indexing.httpx.Client         ← context manager pattern for indexnow_submit
  gsc_mcp.tools.indexing.validate_url_strict  ← patch for indexnow_submit SSRF validation
  gsc_mcp.tools.technical.safe_fetch_html     ← patch for ai_visibility_audit + gbp_deprecation_lint
  gsc_mcp.tools.technical.validate_url_strict ← patch for ai_visibility_audit + gbp_deprecation_lint + pagespeed_audit SSRF
  gsc_mcp.tools.technical.httpx.Client        ← context manager pattern for pagespeed_audit
  gsc_mcp.tools.content.safe_fetch_html       ← also covers heading_audit
  gsc_mcp.tools.links.safe_fetch_html         ← internal_links_audit fetch + SSRF/HTTP error paths
  gsc_mcp.tools.links.get_search_analytics    ← link_equity_map GSC page list (module-level import)
  gsc_mcp.providers.bing.httpx.Client         ← Bing transport, context manager pattern
  gsc_mcp.tools.bing_analytics.get_bing_client ← Bing performance and backlink reads
  gsc_mcp.tools.bing_webmaster.get_bing_client ← Bing site, crawl, URL, feed and write tools
  gsc_mcp.tools.search_compare.get_search_provider ← cross-engine provider batches

## Environment Variables

GSC_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_PATH  : GSC + Indexing + GA4 tools. Path to service account JSON (preferred for automation).
GSC_CREDENTIALS_PATH      : OAuth flow. Path to OAuth Desktop client JSON.
GSC_SKIP_OAUTH            : Set to "true" to skip OAuth fallback entirely (requires SA path).
GA4_PROPERTY_ID           : All GA4 + cross tools. Numeric (e.g. 12345678), validated lazily, per-call override supported.
CRUX_API_KEY              : crux_page_vitals, crux_history, crux_lcp_subparts. Plain Google API key (not service account).
                            Missing CRUX_API_KEY: crux_page_vitals + crux_history raise RuntimeError; crux_lcp_subparts returns verdict="missing_key".
GOOGLE_API_KEY            : pagespeed_audit only. Plain Google API key with PageSpeed Insights API enabled in GCP.
                            Missing GOOGLE_API_KEY: returns verdict="missing_key" (no exception).
BING_WEBMASTER_API_KEY    : all bing_* tools. User-level key shared by verified sites visible to the account.
                            Site stays a per-call argument. Never expose this value in tool arguments or errors.
INDEXNOW KEY              : not an env var in the current code. indexnow_submit receives a distinct key argument
                            that must be verifiable on each target host or subdomain.

## Quick Decision Tree

- New GSC analytics tool → analytics.py, use _fetch_rows, @with_retry, with_meta
- New SEO intelligence tool → seo.py, builds on _fetch_rows
- New GA4 tool → ga4.py, add hostname+country filter via _build_dimension_filter, with_meta
- New GA4 alpha API tool → ga4.py, use get_alpha_ga4_service()
- New cross-platform tool → cross.py, use _normalize_url for GSC+GA4 join
- New search-provider metric → providers/<engine>.py, preserve the minimal common schema and provider_metrics
- New Bing API method → validate the redacted live contract, then add it to the JSON/HTTP client allowlist
- New cross-engine delta → require equal exact observed windows; never subtract positions
- New tool fetching external URLs → use safe_fetch_html() from url_safety.py (SSRF, DNS rebinding, metadata blocklist)
- New tool parsing external XML → defusedxml.ElementTree
- New tool proposing deletion/noindex/consolidation → read clicks + impressions + indexing status over >=90 days first (prune_candidates or get_search_analytics); never rank on content length or template similarity alone
- Any Google API call → @with_retry()
- Any tool return → json.dumps(with_meta(...))
- New tool registered → update registry.TOOLS and properties._ALL_TOOLS; counts are derived
- New test → mock get_*_service at call site, never make real API calls

BOUNDED AUDIT WORKFLOWS: docs/audit-workflows.md
  search_change_breakdown(site, baseline_start, baseline_end, comparison_start, comparison_end, dimensions=None, filters=None, search_type="web", data_state="final", aggregation_type="auto", row_limit=1000, max_requests=20, limit=50, output_max_bytes=None): Google-only equal ordered inclusive windows; one or more independent dimension views, source keys, null unavailable metrics, physical request budget, coverage and noncausal residuals. A deterministic snapshot fingerprint identifies exact provenance without storing the report. Optional output_max_bytes covers the entire UTF-8 JSON envelope including metadata; a too-small budget produces an explicit error. CLI preserves JSON output.
  link_targets_audit(url, max_targets=30, max_requests=60): source and destination GETs share budget; terminal statuses differ from unavailable requests; no target body reads, recursive crawl or ranking claim.

RELEASE 1.4.0: 89 tools; releases 1.3.0 and 1.3.1 contain 85.
  change_impact.py (1 tool): seo_change_impact(event, baseline_start, baseline_end, comparison_start, comparison_end, filters=None, search_type="web", align_weekdays=False, page_mapping=None, concurrent_changes=None, row_limit=1000, max_requests=20, limit=50). Caller-declared event; GSC calendar/windows/coverage; no persistence or causal attribution. See docs/audit-workflows.md.
  editorial_drafts.py (adapter, no additional tool): exactly one URL or caller text; plain/markdown subset, explicit draft FR/EN, Unicode native spans and protected exclusions. Auto draft language unavailable.
  rewrite.py (1 tool): rewrite_fidelity_check(original, revised, language="en", format="plain"). Mechanical review candidates; no factual-truth/authorship/fidelity verdict even with zero findings. See docs/editorial-workflows.md.
  traffic_reference.py (1 tool): search_weekday_reference(site, days=28, end_date=None, dimensions=None, filters=None, search_type="web", aggregation_type="auto", row_limit=1000, max_requests=20, limit=50). Final-requested equal disjoint Google windows shifted by whole weeks, same weekdays, ending no later than Pacific today minus three days; incomplete coverage is unavailable, annual/causal inference unproved.
  crawl_import.py (1 tool): crawl_import_preview(report_json, producer="siteone"). Bounded in-memory preview of caller-provided SiteOne JSON; no file, crawler, network, credential or GSC join. Imported scores are producer heuristics.
  .claude workflow pilot: 12 tests passed in a controlled host; native Claude runtime and model quality unverified. Python PR CI is owner-gated; publishing reruns the test suite and checks the built wheel before upload.

RELEASE 1.5.0: crawl_logs.py adds crawl_log_audit(log_path, site, profile="combined"). Read-only bounded local common/combined logs, explicit timezone offsets, masked IPs/paths/queries, optional one-fetch current Google range membership. Historical identity and indexing remain unverified. No DNS, persistence, uploads or joins. The source registry has 96 tools.

RELEASE 1.5.0: 96 tools. New: crawl_log_audit, crawl_snapshot_import/read/delete/join, crawl_diff, indexing_evidence_matrix. Versioned caller-owned bounded local snapshots, explicit write/cleanup choices, exact raw URL GSC joins, disclosed path-aggregated link evidence, source-referenced contradictions and unknown current indexing/rendering. Optional content_quality extractor="trafilatura-precision" requires the content extra; default extraction unchanged. Richer weekday/year_on_year/rolling_daily references are descriptive and retain observed-window coverage. See docs/crawl-snapshots.md, docs/indexing-evidence-matrix.md, docs/content-extraction.md. No native-agent or human accuracy proof.
